models.name: Ornith 1.5 9B

engines.quant: MTP on (draft acceptance 0.95, mean draft length 2.27), q8 KV caches; memory bandwidth and GPU utilisation halved vs MTP off

models.why: Ornith 1.5 9B through llama.cpp with Multi-Token Prediction hit only ~15 tok/s generation and ~200 tok/s prompt processing on an 8GB RTX 4060: the MTP head's own KV cache and activations pushed a layer or two across PCIe into system RAM, so near-perfect 0.95 draft acceptance still cost half the speed.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.quant: Unsloth IQ4_XS, 25 GPU layers offloaded, Q4_0 KV cache, native MTP

models.why: Qwen3.8-27B runs a 64,000-token context on an 8GB RTX 4060 laptop by splitting the 14.6GB IQ4_XS weights between 25 GPU layers and system RAM, at ~5 tok/s decode and 150 tok/s prefill — slow, but proof the 27B dense model fits a mainstream 8GB card without VRAM overflow.
